title: Create in me a clean heart

request.style: English, female solo voice with soft choir, acoustic guitar, piano, strings, gentle mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I was born in guilt and sin
My mother conceived me in shame
You delight in truth within
Teach me wisdom in the hidden place

[Pre-Chorus]
Cleanse me with hyssop now
Wash me and I will be clean
Whiter than snow I become
When your hand removes the stain

[Chorus]
Create in me a clean heart, O God
Renew a steadfast spirit within me
Do not cast me from your presence
Do not take your holy Spirit from me

[Verse]
Hide your face from my sins
Blot out all my guilt and shame
Let me hear joy and gladness
Let the bones you crushed rejoice

[Chorus]
Create in me a clean heart, O God
Renew a steadfast spirit within me
Do not cast me from your presence
Do not take your holy Spirit from me

[Bridge]
Truth is deep in your nature
Wisdom in the hidden place
I am washed by your mercy
Whiter than snow in your grace

[Chorus]
Create in me a clean heart, O God
Renew a steadfast spirit within me
Do not cast me from your presence
Do not take your holy Spirit from me

[Outro]
Steadfast spirit within me
Holy Spirit remain
